rows.test: GET / and /countries returned 200 on 2026-11-04. No language picker and no saved country.
rows.notes: English is hard-coded in the screens. French exists only in the privacy text. Country is chosen by the visitor, not detected.

rows.test: GET /login returned 200. Email, Google and X buttons are in the form. Not proven with a new account.
rows.notes: Sign up is visible in the header. One-time codes by SMS or email do not exist.

rows.feature: Age check before anything is saved
rows.test: The list screen asks the age question and the server stores age_checks before a draft or a publish.
rows.notes: A listing is not saved unless the signed-in person confirmed they are 18 or older.

rows.feature: One-time codes by SMS and email
rows.test: No SMS or email provider is configured.
rows.notes: Needs a sender account. Nothing can be proven until then.

rows.feature: Consent pop-up before a profile is public
rows.test: Code saves a consent row and search hides drafts. Not clicked through on a phone.
rows.notes: Boxes start unticked. Withdrawal is not proven.

rows.test: GET /list returned 200. One skill, place, photos and a document field exist.
rows.notes: No second skill, price range, availability or draft-after-every-step. Public does not require 3 photos.

rows.test: File picker, compression to 2560px and database storage exist. No phone camera, HEIC, drag, paste or resume test.
rows.notes: Server does not enforce 3 to 12 photos. Identity-card names are refused. The picture itself is not checked for an ID card.

rows.test: No voice recorder in the app.
rows.notes: Social links are plain links. They are not labelled as the talent's own pages.

rows.test: GET /find returned 200 and rendered listing cards.
rows.notes: No timed 4G test. Empty and error states exist in code, not proven.

rows.test: Search and the home list use the country the visitor opened. A profile from another country shows only the skill and country name.
rows.notes: Opening a country page saves it on this device. There is no IP detection.

rows.test: Country boards sort by the views column. Opt-out is a consent box. Bots and self-clicks are not filtered.
rows.notes: There is no separate Most contacted board.

rows.test: GET /match lists real published people for a chosen country and skill. Empty skills say no one is listed.
rows.notes: No invented score. It is a filtered search.

rows.feature: Contact request, details hidden until Accept
rows.test: Public rows no longer include phone or email. A signed-in person sends a request. The talent accepts from Requests.
rows.notes: Social links stay public. Email and phone appear only after Accept. Eight requests a day.

rows.test: Accepted requests can exchange short messages on /inbox. No translation provider is connected.
rows.notes: Chat is stored in the app. Translation stays off until a translation key exists.

rows.test: Job-confirm and vouch tables exist. A neighbour phone code and one-review rule are not proven.
rows.notes: Not the full review flow in section 3.

rows.feature: Work checked badge, reports and appeals
rows.test: Report button and review queue exist. Duplicate-image detection across countries is not proven.
rows.notes: The badge must never say verified person. Copy currently says the work was checked.

rows.test: No PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY in this environment. Webhook route exists at /api/paystack/webhook.
rows.notes: Prices are in config and the admin screen. A real payment cannot be proven. Wallet ledger is on for staff.

rows.test: GET /card and /admin returned 200. Numbers were not checked against the database.
rows.notes: No seeker dashboard. No two-step admin sign-in. Wallet, price, verify and remove actions are not locked to a staff role.

rows.test: Buttons exist on My ID. Deletion is not proven against a live row.
rows.notes: Privacy page is published. A lawyer still has to approve the text.

rows.test: GET /sw.js returned 200. Manifest at /__grok/manifest.webmanifest is named Grok App, not Talent Finder.
rows.notes: High. Install would use the wrong name and icon until the manifest identity is set. Offline only caches the home page.

rows.test: Lighthouse was not run. No 4G phone was available.
rows.notes: Do not claim 90 until a run on a mid-range phone.
